title: Systemic Inflammation and Molar Incisor Hypomineralisation: A Cohort Study
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Molar incisor hypomineralisation (MIH) is a common developmental dental defect of unknown etiology and considerable morbidity. Observational and experimental studies suggest systemic inflammation as a key mechanism, but there are no prospective human ...
